requirements.text: Offerors must be registered and active in SAM.gov under NAICS 336611 at the time of offer.
Offerors must hold a Master Ship Repair Agreement or an Agreement for Boat Repair with the Navy.
Offerors must provide evidence of an ISO 9O01 certified quality management system.
The contractor shaII overhaul 96 shipboard valves in accordance with the applicable technical repair standard.
The contractor shaII retum each overhauled valve to the shipyard within 45 calendar days of receipt.
The contractor must perform hydrostatic testing on every valve and provide the certified test record.
The contractor shaII tag and package each valve in accordance with military packaging requirements.
Offers shaII be submitted on the Standard Form 1449 provided with this solicitation.
Offers must be received at the Norfolk Naval Shipyard contracting office by 11:O0 AM Eastem Time on 7 December 2026.
Offerors shaII submit a completed pricing schedule for all 96 valves.
Award wiII be made to the responsible offeror whose offer represents the lowest evaluated price.
The Govemment wiII verify the offeror's repair facility capacity before award.
